<documents>
<document id="close-blockers">
Whyˆcan'tˆIˆcloseˆmyˆaccount?ˆIfˆtheˆappˆwon'tˆletˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount,ˆoneˆofˆtheseˆisˆusuallyˆtheˆreason.ˆ##ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆWaitˆuntilˆeverythingˆhasˆposted.ˆCardˆauthorizationsˆusuallyˆpostˆorˆdropˆoffˆwithinˆaˆfewˆdays.ˆ##ˆOpenˆdisputesˆWeˆcan'tˆcloseˆanˆaccountˆwhileˆaˆdisputeˆisˆopen,ˆbecauseˆtheˆoutcomeˆmayˆaddˆorˆremoveˆmoney.ˆMostˆdisputesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆrefundedˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆwithdrawˆtheˆdispute.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆtheˆbalanceˆbackˆtoˆzero,ˆwhetherˆit'sˆfromˆCushionˆorˆfromˆaˆreversedˆcredit.ˆ##ˆAccountˆrestrictedˆorˆunderˆreviewˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆorˆunderˆreview,ˆsupportˆcan'tˆcloseˆit.ˆMessageˆusˆandˆwe'llˆpassˆyourˆrequestˆtoˆtheˆteamˆthatˆmanagesˆtheˆreview.ˆ##ˆStillˆstuck?ˆMessageˆsupportˆwithˆtheˆreasonˆtheˆappˆgives.ˆWe'llˆtellˆyouˆexactlyˆwhat'sˆleftˆtoˆdo.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="savings-tax-forms">
TaxˆformsˆforˆinterestˆIfˆyouˆearnˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆduringˆaˆcalendarˆyear,ˆweˆsendˆyouˆaˆFormˆ1099-INT.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆavailableˆByˆJanuaryˆ31ˆofˆtheˆfollowingˆyear.ˆYou'llˆfindˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆTaxˆforms.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆwhenˆit'sˆready.ˆ##ˆEarnedˆless?ˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆlessˆthanˆtheˆthreshold,ˆweˆdon'tˆsendˆaˆform,ˆbutˆtheˆinterestˆisˆstillˆshownˆonˆyourˆmonthlyˆstatements.ˆYouˆmayˆstillˆneedˆtoˆreportˆit.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆandˆbonusesˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆaren'tˆinterestˆandˆdon'tˆappearˆonˆtheˆform.ˆReferralˆbonusesˆmayˆbeˆreportedˆseparately.ˆ##ˆTaxˆquestionsˆWeˆcan'tˆgiveˆtaxˆadvice.ˆForˆquestionsˆaboutˆhowˆtoˆreportˆinterest,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆtaxˆprofessional.ˆ##ˆWrongˆdetailsˆonˆtheˆformˆIfˆyourˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆonˆtheˆformˆisˆwrong,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆChangesˆtoˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆgoˆtoˆourˆVerificationˆteam.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-contact">
ContactingˆsupportˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆreachˆus.ˆ##ˆChatˆinˆtheˆappˆTapˆHelp,ˆthenˆMessageˆus.ˆChatˆisˆopenˆaroundˆtheˆclock,ˆeveryˆday.ˆIt'sˆtheˆfastestˆwayˆtoˆreachˆus,ˆandˆweˆalreadyˆknowˆit'sˆyouˆbecauseˆyou'reˆsignedˆin.ˆ##ˆPhoneˆCallˆ+1ˆ555ˆ0142ˆfromˆ8:00ˆAMˆETˆtoˆ8:00ˆPMˆET,ˆeveryˆday.ˆYou'llˆbeˆaskedˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆcodeˆinˆtheˆappˆtoˆproveˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆEmailˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆWeˆreplyˆbyˆemail,ˆbutˆforˆyourˆsecurityˆweˆcan'tˆmakeˆchangesˆtoˆyourˆaccountˆbyˆemail.ˆ##ˆSpecialistˆteamsˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆsuchˆasˆFraud,ˆDisputesˆorˆVerification.ˆTheyˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆBewareˆofˆfakesˆOnlyˆuseˆtheˆcontactˆdetailsˆinˆtheˆappˆorˆonˆthisˆhelpˆcenter.ˆScammersˆpostˆfakeˆsupportˆnumbersˆonline.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
